# Analytics And Feedback

Use this instruction when measuring product usage and collecting insight.

## Core Focus

- Track the baseline product metrics, including number of tools, end users, and AI sessions.
- Provide a usage dashboard for each coach.
- Add in-app feedback collection.
- Collect testimonials from early users.
- Produce a recurring internal report that summarizes usage and feedback.

## Output Expectations

- Track only metrics that can change product or business decisions.
- Pair quantitative metrics with qualitative feedback.
- Keep coach-facing analytics simple enough to interpret without assistance.
